questions.text: A mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 7:3. When 10 litres of water is added, the ratio becomes 7:5. What was the initial quantity of the mixture?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Let initial milk = 7x, water = 3x. After adding 10 L water, water = 3x+10. New ratio 7x/(3x+10) = 7/5 → 35x = 21x+70 → 14x=70 → x=5. Initial mixture = 10x = 50 L. Full: Set up equation from ratios, solve for x, compute total.

questions.text: A shopkeeper marks his goods 50% above the cost price. He allows a discount of 20% on the marked price and then an additional discount of 10% on the reduced price. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use Multiplying Factors. MP/CP = 1.5. Net Spf actor = 0.8 × 0.9 = 0.72. SP/CP = 1.5 × 0.72 = 1.08 → 8% profit. Step-by-step: Let CP = ₹100. MP = ₹150. After 20% discount, price = ₹120. After further 10% discount, SP = ₹108. Profit = ₹8 on ₹100 CP = 8%.

questions.text: The sides of a right-angled triangle are in the ratio 5 : 12 : 13. If its perimeter is 120 cm, what is the radius (in cm) of the inscribed circle?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Sides are \(5k, 12k, 13k\). Perimeter \(30k=120 \Rightarrow k=4\). Sides: 20, 48, 52. For a right triangle, inradius \(r = \frac{a+b-c}{2} = \frac{20+48-52}{2} = 8\). Full Solution: Let sides be \(5x, 12x, 13x\). Perimeter \(= 30x = 120 \Rightarrow x=4\). Sides are 20 cm, 48 cm, 52 cm. Area \(= \frac{1}{2} \times 20 \times 48 = 480 \text{ cm}^2\). Semi-perimeter \(s = 60 \text{ cm}\). Inradius \(r = \frac{\text{Area}}{s} = \frac{480}{60} = 8 \text{ cm}\).

questions.text: Deficiency of which vitamin leads to impaired blood clotting and increased bleeding tendency due to reduced synthesis of prothrombin?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use elimination by matching famous deficiency pairs: Vit A → Night Blindness; Vit B1 → Beri-Beri; Vit C → Scurvy. The only remaining option, Vitamin K, is the co-factor for gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors II, VII, IX, X. Step-by-step: Vitamin K (Phylloquinone/Menaquinone) is a fat-soluble vitamin essential for the hepatic synthesis of clotting factors II (prothrombin), VII, IX, and X. Its deficiency causes prolonged prothrombin time and hemorrhagic disease, particularly in newborns (VKDB) or due to malabsorption.

questions.text: Which of the following was added as a Fundamental Duty by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002?

options.label: A
options.text: To protect and improve the natural environment including forests, lakes, rivers and wildlife

options.label: B
options.text: To provide opportunities for education to his child or ward between the age of six and fourteen years

options.label: C
options.text: To safeguard public property and to abjure violence

options.label: D
options.text: To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India

questions.solution: Shortcut: Link the 86th Amendment (2002) directly to the Right to Education (Article 21A). The corresponding duty on parents/guardians was inserted as Article 51A(k). Full Solution: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added the original 10 Fundamental Duties (Article 51A). The 86th Amendment Act, 2002 inserted Article 21A (Right to Education for 6-14 years) and consequently added clause (k) to Article 51A, making it a duty of every parent/guardian to provide education opportunities to their child/ward in that age group. Options A, C, and D were part of the original 1976 list.

questions.text: Rohan walks 6 kmno rth, turns right and walks 8 km, turns left and walks 6 km, then turns right and walks 8 km. What is the straight-line distance from his starting point?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Net North displacement = 6 + 6 = 12 km. Net East displacement = 8 + 8 = 16 km. Recognize 12-16-20 as a 3-4-5 Pythagorean triplet multiplied by 4. Distance = 20 km. Full Solution: Movements: N(6), E(8), N(6), E(8). Final position is 12 kmno rth and 16 km East of start. Distance = √(12² + 16²) = √(144 + 256) = √400 = 20 km.

questions.text: Find the missing term in the series: Z1A, X2D, V6G, T24J, ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Split series. 1st Letter: -2 steps (Z,X,V,T,R). Number: Factorial pattern (x1, x2, x3, x4, x5 -> 1,2,6,24,120). 3rd Letter: +3 steps (A,D,G,J,M). Combine: R120M. Step-by-step: 1st letters: Z(-2)->X(-2)->V(-2)->T(-2)->R. Numbers: 1x2=2, 2x3=6, 6x4=24, 24x5=120. 3rd letters: A(+3)->D(+3)->G(+3)->J(+3)->M. Missing term: R120M.

questions.text: Under the Flexible Inflation Targeting Framework (FITF) adopted in India in 2016, who is responsible for notifying the inflation target (in terms of CPI) once in every five years?

options.label: A
options.text: The Central Government (in consultation with the RBI)

questions.solution: Shortcut: Target Setting = Government (Executive); Target Achieving = RBI/MPC (Central Bank). The amended RBI Act (Section 45ZA) mandates the Central Govt to fix the target. Full Solution: The Finance Act, 2016 amended the RBI Act, 1934, establishing a statutory basis for FITF. Under Section 45ZA, the Central Government, in consultation with the RBI, notifies the inflation target (currently 4% with +/- 2% tolerance band) for a period of five years. The MPC (headed by RBI Governor) determines the policy interest rate (repo rate) required to achieve this target. The Finance Commission deals with Centre-State fiscal transfers.

questions.text: One who loves books is called:
questions.solution: Shortcut: Break the word: 'biblio-' means book, '-phile' means lover. So 'bibliophile' means book lover. Eliminate others: philanthropist (lover of mankind), philologist (language scholar), bibliophobe (fear of books). Step-by-step: Identify root meanings; match to the definition 'one who loves books'; select the option that corresponds to 'bibliophile'.

questions.text: Choose the synonym of the word "Ephemeral":
questions.solution: Shortcut: "Ephemeral" means lasting a very short time. Scan the options for a word with the same sense; "Transient" directly conveys short‑lived. Eliminate "Eternal", "Permanent", and "Enduring" as they mean the opposite. Step‑by‑step: 1) Recall the meaning of ephemeral. 2) Compare each option's meaning. 3) Select the one matching short duration.

questions.text: The Cabinet Mission Plan (1946) proposed a three-tier federal structure for India. Which of the following correctly describes the composition of 'Group B' provinces in the plan?

options.label: A
options.text: Punjab, North-West Frontier Province, Sindh, and British Baluchistan

options.label: C
options.text: Madras, Bombay, Central Provinces, United Provinces, Bihar, and Orissa

questions.solution: Shortcut: Memorize Group B as 'Western Muslim Majority' (Punjab, NWFP, Sindh, Baluchistan). Group A = Hindu Majority provinces. Group C = Bengal & Assam (Eastern Muslim Majority). Princely States were not grouped; they were to negotiate separately. Detailed Solution: The Cabinet Mission Plan grouped British Indian provinces into three sections based on religious majority. Group B consisted of the Muslim-majority provinces in the northwest: Punjab, North-West Frontier Province (NWFP), Sindh, and British Baluchistan. Group A comprised Hindu-majority provinces, and Group Ccomprised Bengal and Assam.

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'GRAPE' is written as 'TIZKV'. How will 'MANGO' be written in that language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use Atbash cipher (Reverse alphabet positions: A=Z, B=Y...). G(7)->T(20), R(18)->I(9), A(1)->Z(26), P(16)->K(11), E(5)->V(22). Apply same to MANGO: M(13)->N(14), A->Z, N(14)->M(13), G->T, O(15)->L(12) = NZMTL. Step-by-step: Verify pattern with GRAPE -> TIZKV (each letter replaced by its reverse positional counterpart). Apply to M->N, A->Z, N->M, G->T, O->L. Result: NZMTL.

questions.text: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. A alone can complete the same work in 20 days. In how many days can B alone complete the work?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 1/B = 1/12 - 1/20 = (5-3)/60 = 2/60 = 1/30 → B = 30 days. Full: Work done by A+B in 1 day = 1/12. Work done by A in 1 day = 1/20. So B's 1 day work = 1/12 - 1/20 = 1/30. Hence B alone takes 30 days.

questions.text: If 'P + Q' means 'P is the father of Q', 'P - Q' means 'P is the mother of Q', 'P × Q' means 'P is the brother of Q', and 'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the sister of Q', then in the expression 'A + B × C - D ÷ E', how is A related to E?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Track generation gaps: '+'/'-' change generation by ±1; '×'/'÷' keep same generation. Path: A(+1)→B(0)→C(-1)→D(0)→E. Net gap = +2 (Grandparent). Gender check: A is Male (+), C is Female (-). Since the link to E passes through a female (C), A is Maternal Grandfather. Full: A+B ⇒ A father of B. B×C ⇒ B brother of C ⇒ A father of C. C-D ⇒ C mother of D ⇒ A maternal grandfather of D. D÷E ⇒ D sister of E ⇒ A maternal grandfather of E.

questions.text: Choose the best improvement for the sentence: "She likes dancing, singing, and to paint."

options.label: A
options.text: She likes dancing, singing, and painting.

options.label: B
options.text: She likes to dance, sing, and paint.

options.label: C
options.text: She likes dancing, to sing, and painting.

questions.solution: Shortcut: Items in a list after "likes" must be parallel – all gerunds or all infinitives. Option A makes all three gerunds (dancing, singing, painting). Step‑by‑step: The original mixes gerunds (dancing, singing) with an infinitive (to paint). Converting the infinitive to a gerund yields a fully parallel structure, which is the standard correction.
